purpose: test a gentle softening chain on an EXISTING recording before any new generation (owner's note: the voice sounds sharp)
source: ep01 full take (generation fzjITWRAzial3C3ezAkg), 0.3–13.5 s; no new voice was generated for this test
matched: all three clips gain-matched to -16.0 LUFS integrated (static gain + soft limiter), so the comparison is not a loudness trick

chains.A-stronger: highpass 70 Hz; peak EQ 3.5 kHz -2 dB (w 1.0); high shelf 7.5 kHz -3 dB; deesser i=0.3 m=0.5
chains.B-chosen: highpass 70 Hz; peak EQ 3.5 kHz -1.5 dB (w 1.0); high shelf 8 kHz -2 dB; deesser i=0.15 m=0.4

intelligibility_proxy: faster-whisper medium recognised the same words in all three clips (including the same pre-existing slip on «بمئتي»)
choice: B: gentler on the 5-9 kHz consonant band (-3.1 dB vs -5.5 dB in A) while roughly halving sibilant spikes
not_proven: nobody has listened yet; these measurements do not show that the harshness is gone. The original take stays untouched; the chain is applied to a copy.
